sources.finding: Direction: notes, Windows native build in progress, bigger swarms; boundaries: no account, no hosted relay, diagnostics can be turned off, agents not sandboxed.

sources.finding: GNU AGPL-3.0; copyright 2026 Cristian Cretu and diri contributors.

sources.title: Privacy notice
sources.locator: Diagnostics; Where it goes; Your controls
sources.finding: No account; diagnostics (crashes, hangs, timings, session ids, agent names, hashed folders) uploaded hourly by default to a project Cloudflare Worker, kept 30 days; terminal contents never recorded; Settings switch and DIRI_TELEMETRY=off.

sources.title: Security model
sources.finding: Not a sandbox: agents run with user privileges; worktrees are not a security boundary; SSH is the remote trust boundary with no relay.

sources.title: Telemetry contract
sources.finding: Local flight recorder spool with allowed fields only; upload separately controllable; DIRI_TELEMETRY=off disables recording; dev builds do not upload.

sources.title: Account profiles
sources.finding: Switch Claude Code or Codex login for every open tab keeping one conversation home; shows plan windows and resets.

sources.title: Recipes and scheduled tasks
sources.finding: Recipes (saved launches) implemented; document labels a scheduling proposal as not implemented while the release ships a schedule engine (see schedule.rs).

sources.title: diri for iPhone
sources.finding: SwiftUI client talks to diri-web on the Mac over HTTP; creates local or SSH sessions, sends prompts, answers questions, follows terminal output, reviews changes.

sources.title: MCP tool catalog
sources.finding: Tools: spawn_agent(s), fork_agent, submit_task(s), wait_for_task, wait_any, report_task, answer_task, cancel_task, schedule_agent, list/delete schedules, get_diff, integrate, create/list/remove_worktree, manage_agent (hibernate/wake/resume), release_agent, notes tools, browser, computer, test_run, layout/actions.

sources.title: Engine MCP endpoint
sources.finding: Engine serves MCP over loopback Streamable HTTP with per-session HMAC bearer token reaching the agent only through the PTY environment.

sources.title: Schedule rules
sources.finding: Five-field cron in local time; each occurrence claimed at most once; missed occurrences collapse to one catch-up run or are recorded missed.

sources.title: Wake helper
sources.finding: Privileged diri-wake-helper (approved in Login Items) schedules Mac wake for runs and can sleep the Mac again.

sources.title: File triggers
sources.finding: Folder watch triggers hand new files to an agent as batches; edits to existing paths never fire.

sources.title: Resource governor
sources.finding: Sweeps session process trees every 30 s for memory footprints and ports; per-session limit, sustained-idle freeze and global memory budget freeze only idle unattended sessions.

sources.title: PR monitor
sources.finding: Polls GitHub through gh for PRs captured as artifacts: state, review decision, mergeability, CI checks, comments, line stats; inert without gh.

sources.title: Session artifacts
sources.finding: Extracts and classifies URLs (PRs, Linear issues, previews, plain links) from a session terminal and OSC 8 hyperlinks into session artifacts.

sources.title: Worktree health
sources.finding: Local worktree inventory and conservative confirmed cleanup; no fetch or branch deletion.

sources.title: Usage pricing estimates
sources.finding: API-equivalent pricing estimates for transcript fallbacks, labelled estimates not billing; plan windows per account.

sources.title: Attention tracking
sources.finding: Single owner for inferred wait episodes and native request identities.

sources.title: Agent manifests
sources.finding: Manifests for aider, amp, antigravity, claude-code, cline, codex, copilot, cursor, devin, droid, gemini, grok, hermes, kilo, kimi, kiro, maki, opencode, pi, qoder, whipcode, generic and shell.

sources.title: Phone access gateway
sources.finding: App-lifetime phone gateway with persisted owner-only pairing token or Tailscale WhoIs identity with per-device revoke; no public bind.
